initial_no_auto_pack.detail: No extracted pack, implicit skillet definition or JAR asset fallback

reload_no_auto_pack.detail: No extracted pack, implicit skillet definition or JAR asset fallback

manual_install.detail: Standalone content ZIP loads through CE reload

english_server_and_region_locale.detail: Real configured I18n locale and permission template resolve to English; en_gb matches English and explicit zh_cn remains Chinese (no physical client is simulated)

english_reload_message.detail: Actual I18n formatting binds both reload parameters without a dangling issues placeholder

english_native_category_translations.detail: Native CE translation manager resolves all ten generated category labels in English and Chinese plus the English branded root

english_native_tank_translations.detail: Native CE resolves tank names, capacity/use/automation/empty/contains tooltips, bound bucket-to-bottle conversion and two-argument fluid name/amount in both English and Chinese; client drawing still needs a real client

pressure_pool.detail: Sugar cane 14/15; both pressure blocks and mature sapling visuals registered

mushroom_worldgen.detail: Both brown/red colonies and both placed features decode on the native server

recovered_player_items.detail: 22 unconditional recovered items build with their correct CE IDs without the previous external pack

basket_properties_preserve_storage_woode.detail: All six orientations and waterlogged/enabled property transitions preserve the same 27-slot storage and seven diamonds

basket_native_redstone_wooden_basket.detail: A real redstone block immediately toggles enabled in both directions without recreating storage or losing its seven items

basket_properties_preserve_storage_bambo.detail: All six orientations and waterlogged/enabled property transitions preserve the same 27-slot storage and seven diamonds

basket_native_redstone_bamboo_basket.detail: A real redstone block immediately toggles enabled in both directions without recreating storage or losing its seven items

basket_properties_preserve_storage_baske.detail: All six orientations and waterlogged/enabled property transitions preserve the same 27-slot storage and seven diamonds

basket_native_redstone_basket.detail: A real redstone block immediately toggles enabled in both directions without recreating storage or losing its seven items

wet_baskets_and_safety_net.detail: All three basket IDs and the safety net have native water only in their wet states

pie_remaining_signal.detail: Four pies produce comparator strength 4, 3, 2, 1 through their registered native behavior

aligned_behavior_bindings.detail: Native definitions bind independent shrub/rope/fence/gate behaviors; wet and bell-tied states exist

crop_single_grow_cancel.detail: A native BlockGrowEvent cancellation leaves the original CE cabbage age and emits one event

crop_single_grow_commit.detail: Successful native event retains the CE cabbage identity and installs its proposed age exactly once

crop_pitcher_upper_cancel.detail: Real ManagedCrop 2-to-3 growth previews both native events and preserves both cells when the upper event is cancelled

crop_native_structure_guard.detail: A native grow listener changing the planned upper half into lower is rejected without installing either cell

crop_native_input_guard.detail: A real grow event invalidating a controlled input guard blocks both writes; this is not a physical player-hand test

crop_fertilize_event_cancel.detail: An explicit null-player native fertilize event rejects the whole two-cell plan before any grow event or write; no hand consumption is tested

crop_pitcher_blocked_upper.detail: A solid upper cell rejects real 2-to-3 growth without events or partial lower advancement

crop_pitcher_two_cell_commit.detail: Real ManagedCrop growth installs the lower and upper age-three halves after exactly two growth events

crop_pitcher_upper_to_mature.detail: Growing a real upper age-three half matures both synchronized halves to four with one event per changed cell

crop_event_version_guard.detail: An event listener changing the lower cell rejects the full native plan and preserves that external change without placing the upper half

crop_torchflower_native_maturity.detail: The mature vanilla torchflower appearance round-trips through the CE grow-event proposal and retains custom age two

rope_direct_bell.detail: Only the rope directly under a bell is tied, tie renderer exists, and removing the bell clears it; click-to-ring range requires player interaction

rope_connectors.detail: Programmatic restricted rope connects to bars, walls and its rope family, while excluding ordinary stone

rope_waterlogged.detail: Wet rope retains its property and water in both actual native and client visual states; dry rope remains empty

rope_wet_visual_budget.detail: All 32 wet variants share one kelp visual with one shape renderer and optional bell tie; ordinary dry ropes keep block-model rendering

rope_fence_family.detail: Rope fence joins its own family and a full solid side, but neither an oak fence nor an oak gate

rope_gate_two_walls.detail: Rope gate lowers only between two walls and returns when either is removed

rope_gate_connection_axis.detail: Rope fence joins only the post axis of its own gate

basket_live_content_reload.detail: All three placed baskets survive CE content reload, accept old-state redstone updates, and preserve seven tagged diamonds

campfire_support.detail: Shipped config creates tray on a lit campfire with omitted tray flag

extinguish_preserves_input.detail: Physics update clears tray without losing the three ingredients

reignite_coalesced.detail: Twenty notifications coalesce; tray returns and items remain

shape_and_air.detail: Full magma block and air do not produce a tray

chunk_load_refresh.detail: FD chunk-load handler repairs stale support without losing ingredients (existing loaded CE chunk)

intentional_deletion.detail: CE and FD reload preserve deleted recipe/texture; JAR does not backfill assets

wild_worldgen_native_log.detail: No custom wild-block Unknown registry key errors in actual native load log

bundled_native_load_errors.detail: No bundled item/block/placed-feature errors reported by the actual CE parser

no_premature_recipe_warning.detail: No missing-section warning while CE packs have not yet loaded
